symptom: describe workflow -> create or modify on a workflow holding Studio Pro settings MDL cannot state reported "Modified workflow" and reset them: a user task's task name 'Review {1}' became its caption 'Review', the template parameter {1} = $WorkflowContext/Name was dropped, both timer boundary events' captions were blanked, and a non-interrupting timer's recurrence (every 1 Day, at most 5 times) became a one-shot reminder. mx check passed before and after. REPLACE ACTIVITY rebuilt the activity the same way
cause: The rebuild writes a user task's TaskName from the statement's caption, a StringTemplate's Text without Parameters, and a timer boundary event with no Caption and Recurrence null. The rewrite guard (studioProOnlyWorkflowState, rawReplaceLosses) listed only an event handler with no event types and the multi-user/on-created settings, none of these
file: `mdl/executor/validate_workflow_unstatable.go` (new: rawUnstatableWorkflowState, rawUnstatableActivityState), wired into checkNoDroppedWorkflowConstructs and validateAlterReplaceKeepsStudioProState in `mdl/executor/validate_workflow_rewrite.go`
insight: Measure the loss on a stored document that HAS the settings: an mxcli-created workflow has none, so a rewrite of it proves nothing. Without Studio Pro, patch the .mxunit with a small Go program (go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2 bson, run with the repo's toolchain: GOTOOLCHAIN=local and $(go env GOROOT)/bin/go): $ID must be binary subtype 0 (subtype 3 gives "Expected '$ID' as the first property … but got '$ID'"), and a template parameter is Microflows$TemplateParameter, not the gen type's TemplateArgument ("type cache does not contain … TemplateArgument"). mx check then accepted the patched unit — but it also accepted IntervalType 'Bogus', so it does not validate that enum and cannot establish its values (#1716 needs a Studio Pro reference). The sweep found one more than the issue listed: the task name itself, not just its parameters, is reset whenever it differs from the caption. A user task's name/description count only when the statement restates the task (dropping the task drops them on purpose); boundary-event state counts wherever it is, because an unrestated boundary event is refused already
fix: Refuse the rewrite, listing each setting with the issue that adds its syntax: workflow display/description parameters, a restated user task's task name other than its caption and its task name/description parameters (#1714), a timer boundary event's caption (#1715), its recurrence (#1716), and a boundary event annotation. REPLACE ACTIVITY refuses the same for the replaced activity
